abstract: We present a model of associative networks that captures how decision makers expand their consideration set through mental associations between alternatives. Our model provides a tractable approach to study how associations shape choice when some alternatives are available and others are merely observable but unavailable. We characterize the model within a random attention framework and demonstrate unique identification of all parameters. This framework delivers a unified account of several prominent choice anomalies, including classic menu effects and their “phantom” counterparts. We illustrate how associative links serve as a strategic variable in applications such as branding, imitation, and platform design.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个联想网络模型，用以刻画决策者如何通过备选方案之间的心理联想来扩展其考虑集。该模型提供了一种可操作的方法，用于研究当某些备选方案可用而其他方案仅可观察但不可获得时，联想如何塑造选择行为。我们在随机注意力框架内对该模型进行刻画，并证明所有参数均可唯一识别。此框架统一解释了若干显著的选择异常现象，包括经典菜单效应及其“幻影”对应物。我们进一步说明，在品牌塑造、模仿和平台设计等应用中，联想链接如何作为策略性变量发挥作用。
title: Associative Networks in Decision Making
title_zh: 决策中的联想网络

abstract: This paper estimates state-level trend unemployment rates (trend U-star) based on the trend components of unemployment inflows and outflows across unemployment durations. The estimated trend U-stars, particularly the portions attributable to long-term unemployment, have levels and dynamics that vary substantially across states. Long-term unemployment makes a relatively small contribution to trend U-star in agricultural states, but takes a larger share for Rust Belt states and several states in the Sun Belt. While higher educational attainment and population aging put downward pressure on U-star, the effects of industrial structure and labor-market rigidities are mixed. Using the estimates of state-level trend U-star, we revisit previous work on state-level Phillips curves and find that the estimated slopes of forward-looking inflation equations are driven by movements in trend U-star rather than by cyclical variation in the unemployment rate.
abstract_zh: 本文基于失业流入与流出的趋势成分，估算了各州层面的趋势性失业率（趋势U-star），并覆盖了不同失业持续时间。估算出的趋势U-star，尤其是归因于长期失业的部分，其水平和动态在各州间存在显著差异。在农业州，长期失业对趋势U-star的贡献相对较小，而在锈带州及阳光地带的部分州，其占比则更大。尽管更高的教育水平和人口老龄化对U-star产生下行压力，但产业结构与劳动力市场僵化的影响则呈现混合效应。利用各州趋势U-star的估算值，我们重新审视了先前关于州级菲利普斯曲线的研究，发现前瞻性通胀方程的估计斜率主要由趋势U-star的变动驱动，而非失业率的周期性波动。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国各州失业率与菲利普斯曲线，数据与制度背景均不涉及中国。
title: United States of U-Star
title_zh: U型星联合体

abstract: This study examines the implications of the traditional 40-hour work week using an incomplete-markets model that incorporates both the extensive and intensive margins of labor supply, along with a wage penalty for working fewer hours than a specified threshold. The 40-hour standard emerges as a key driver of labor supply elasticities: micro-level elasticities remain small, whereas macro-level elasticities are larger, reflecting adjustment that occurs primarily along the extensive margin. Households constrained by the 40-hour schedule face the adverse welfare effects of business cycle fluctuations, as the rigid schedule limits their ability to adjust hours in response to wage changes.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用一个包含劳动供给广延边际与集约边际以及低于特定工时阈值时工资惩罚的不完全市场模型，探讨传统每周40小时工作制的含义。40小时标准成为劳动供给弹性的关键驱动因素：微观层面的弹性保持较小，而宏观层面的弹性则较大，反映出调整主要沿广延边际发生。受40小时工作制约束的家庭面临商业周期波动的不利福利影响，因为刚性工作安排限制了其根据工资变化调整工时的能力。
title: The 40-Hour Work Week
title_zh: 每周40小时工作制

abstract: The Vietnam draft conscripted hundreds of thousands of young Americans into an integrated military. I combine near-random draft lottery variation with administrative voter data to study the long-run racial integration effects of coerced national service. Black and Native American veterans became more likely to marry white spouses, identify as Republicans, and live in more-integrated neighborhoods. Improved economic standing may partly mediate these effects. Effects are larger for Southerners and are precisely null for white veterans. Coerced military service generates substantial but asymmetric cross-racial political convergence and racial integration: Vietnam-era service caused about 20 percent of affected cohorts’ interracial marriages.
abstract_zh: 越南征兵制度将数十万美国青年征召入一支种族融合的军队。我将近乎随机的征兵抽签变动与行政选民数据相结合，研究强制国民服役的长期种族融合效应。黑人和美洲原住民退伍军人更有可能与白人配偶结婚、认同共和党身份，并居住于种族融合程度更高的社区。经济地位的提升可能部分中介了这些效应。效应在南方人中更为显著，而对白人退伍军人则精确为零。强制兵役产生了显著但不对称的跨种族政治趋同与种族融合：越战时期的服役导致了受影响群体中约20%的跨种族婚姻。
title: The Vietnam War and Racial Integration
title_zh: 越南战争与种族融合

abstract: This review assesses John Campbell and Tarun Ramadorai’s book entitled Fixed. Why Personal Finance is Broken and How to Make It Work for Everyone. The volume is an excellent discussion of the research on household finances around the world. Most importantly, the authors examine how and why the financial system tends to fail instead of helping consumers and retail investors. Campbell and Ramadorai also propose solutions to the problem, including stronger regulation and simplified financial instruments. However, if the system is to work for most of us, an additional factor is required: better financial literacy. Indeed, enhancing financial knowledge is essential if people are to be empowered to make better financial decisions, guard against deceptive practices, utilize financial instruments to their benefit, and take advantage of the opportunities offered by financial markets and the government. Without such basic knowledge, regulation and simplified financial instruments will not fix personal finance.
abstract_zh: 本综述评价了约翰·坎贝尔与塔伦·拉马多拉伊合著的《固定收益：为何个人理财失灵及如何使其惠及所有人》一书。该书对全球家庭金融研究进行了精彩论述。最重要的是，作者探讨了金融体系为何及如何倾向于失灵，而非帮助消费者和散户投资者。坎贝尔与拉马多拉伊还提出了解决方案，包括加强监管和简化金融工具。然而，若要使该体系惠及大多数人，还需一个额外因素：更好的金融素养。确实，提升金融知识对于赋予人们做出更优财务决策、防范欺诈行为、利用金融工具获益以及把握金融市场和政府提供的机会至关重要。缺乏这种基础知识，监管和简化金融工具将无法修复个人理财问题。
title: Why Financial Literacy Is Essential for Fixing a Broken Personal Finance System: A Review of Fixed: Why Personal Finance Is Broken and How to Make It Work for Everyone by John Y. Campbell and Tarun Ramadorai
title_zh: 金融素养为何对修复失灵的个人金融体系至关重要：《固定：个人金融为何失灵及如何使其惠及所有人》述评

abstract: In designing priority-based matching problems such as school choice, the quota of each school is, to some extent, a design variable. We define an ex-post student-optimal stable matching (ESOSM) as a matching that is stable at some implementable quota distribution and not Pareto dominated by any other stable matching among all implementable quota distributions. We propose a novel mechanism called a quota adjustment process (QAP) that improves existing stable mechanisms by endogenously finding an ESOSM and the corresponding optimal quota distribution for any preference relation. This method has been successfully implemented at the University of Tsukuba in Japan since 2021.
abstract_zh: 在设计基于优先级的匹配问题（如学校选择）时，每所学校的配额在一定程度上是一个设计变量。我们将事后学生最优稳定匹配（ESOSM）定义为在某种可实施的配额分配下稳定，并且不被任何其他在所有可实施配额分配中的稳定匹配所帕累托支配的匹配。我们提出了一种新颖的机制，称为配额调整过程（QAP），该机制通过内生地寻找ESOSM及相应的最优配额分配，以改善现有的稳定机制，适用于任何偏好关系。自2021年起，该方法已在日本筑波大学成功实施。
title: Quota Adjustment Process
title_zh: 配额调整过程

abstract: We estimate the causal effect of a large-scale cash assistance program for refugee returnees on conflict in Afghanistan. Leveraging historical returnee settlement patterns and novel combat records, we find that policy-induced return had cross-cutting effects, reducing insurgent violence but increasing social conflict. Cash assistance may have raised reservation wages in returnee-receiving communities, reducing labor-intensive combat, increasing lethality of capital-intensive attacks, and reducing counterinsurgent effectiveness. Social capital and local institutions significantly offset risks of communal violence after repatriation. Together, these results highlight unintended consequences of repatriation assistance programs, and clarify conditions under which refugee return affects conflict.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了一项针对阿富汗难民返乡者的大规模现金援助项目对冲突的因果效应。利用历史返乡者定居模式及新颖的战斗记录，我们发现政策驱动的返乡产生了交叉影响，既减少了叛乱暴力，又加剧了社会冲突。现金援助可能提高了返乡者接收社区的保留工资，从而减少了劳动密集型战斗，增加了资本密集型攻击的致命性，并削弱了反叛乱行动的有效性。社会资本与地方机构显著抵消了遣返后社区暴力的风险。综合来看，这些结果揭示了遣返援助项目的意外后果，并阐明了难民返乡影响冲突的条件。
title: Refugee Return and Conflict: Evidence from a Natural Experiment
title_zh: 难民回归与冲突：来自自然实验的证据

abstract: We characterize the contribution of immigrants to US innovation. Leveraging new data, we use age of SSN assignment to identify immigrant status. Immigrants represent 16 percent of inventors, but authored 23 percent of patents. Immigrant inventors contribute to knowledge diffusion across borders. They disproportionately rely on foreign technologies and inventor collaborations. Using variation from premature inventor deaths, we find immigrant inventors create stronger innovation productivity spillovers on their collaborators, as compared to US-born inventors. A simple model implies immigrants are responsible for 32 percent of aggregate innovation, over half of which is due to human capital externalities on US-born collaborators.
abstract_zh: 我们刻画了移民对美国创新的贡献。利用新数据，我们通过社保号分配年龄来识别移民身份。移民占发明者的16%，却贡献了23%的专利。移民发明者促进了知识跨国界扩散，他们不成比例地依赖外国技术和发明者合作。利用发明者早逝带来的变异，我们发现与本土出生的发明者相比，移民发明者对其合作者产生了更强的创新生产力溢出效应。一个简单模型表明，移民对总体创新的贡献占32%，其中超过一半归因于对本土合作者的人力资本外部性。
title: The Contribution of High-Skilled Immigrants to Innovation in the United States
title_zh: 高技能移民对美国创新的贡献

abstract: In the 4th millennium BC, our ancestors witnessed a remarkable transformation, progressing from petty chiefdoms to political states and cities. The causes of this “Urban Revolution” remain unclear. We conjecture that the discovery of bronze and the ensuing long-distance trade played a crucial role. Using novel panel data and 2SLS techniques, we demonstrate that trade corridors linking metal mines to fertile lands were more likely to experience the Urban Revolution. We propose that transit bottlenecks facilitated the emergence of a new taxing elite. We formally test this appropriability theory and provide several case studies in support.
abstract_zh: 公元前四千年，我们的祖先见证了一场非凡的变革，从小型酋邦演进至政治国家与城市。这场“城市革命”的成因至今未明。我们推测，青铜的发现及其随之而来的长途贸易起到了关键作用。借助新颖的面板数据与两阶段最小二乘法技术，我们证明连接金属矿藏与肥沃土地之间的贸易走廊更可能经历城市革命。我们提出，过境瓶颈促进了新征税精英阶层的兴起。我们正式检验了这一可占有性理论，并提供若干案例研究作为佐证。
title: The Dawn of Civilization Metal Trade and the Rise of Hierarchy
title_zh: 文明曙光：金属贸易与等级制度的兴起

abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们研究了一项哥斯达黎加倡议，该倡议结合了两大支柱：免费获取长效可逆避孕药具；以及一项量身定制的信息宣传活动，旨在提高认识并纠正基线误解。利用行政数据和该倡议的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取途径相辅相成：同时接触两大支柱的地区，其生育率下降幅度显著大于仅能获取避孕药具的地区。通过关于性行为的调查，我们显示该倡议将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗保健专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的误解。
title: The complementary role of information and contraceptive access in teen pregnancy
title_zh: 信息与避孕措施可及性在青少年怀孕中的互补作用

abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title:

title_zh: 纠正消费者对二氧化碳排放的误解

abstract: We estimate the effect of competition on incumbent firm pricing by using high frequency price data and the precise geographic location for all gas stations in California. Using an event study design, we find that the entry of a new station is associated with a 2.5 cent decrease in prices at incumbent stores, which equates to a 7% reduction in estimated retail markups. The effects are immediate, persistent, and show no sign of deterrence or limit pricing behavior. In contrast, nearby exit results in precisely estimated null effects on prices with no evidence of predatory pricing in the lead up to the station departure. The results are consistent across all fuel blends and dissipate with station distance. Finally, we explore the asymmetric effects, showing that the difference cannot be attributed to difference in branding, proximity to highway, or data quality idiosyncrasies, although we find suggestive evidence that exit tends to happen in more competitive markets and amongst less heavily trafficked stations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用高频价格数据和加利福尼亚州所有加油站的精确地理位置，估算了竞争对现有企业定价的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现新加油站的进入导致现有门店价格下降2.5美分，相当于零售加价幅度减少7%。这种影响是即时且持久的，没有表现出任何威慑或限制性定价行为的迹象。相比之下，附近加油站的退出对价格产生了精确估计的零效应，且在退出前未发现掠夺性定价的证据。所有燃料混合物的结果均一致，并随距离增加而减弱。最后，我们探讨了非对称效应，表明这种差异不能归因于品牌差异、高速公路邻近性或数据质量特性，尽管我们发现了暗示性证据，即退出往往发生在竞争更激烈的市场以及交通流量较少的加油站中。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: The Effects of Competition in the Retail Gasoline Industry
title_zh: 零售汽油行业竞争的影响

abstract: Presidential Address: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity by Lawrence F. Katz. Published in volume 116, issue 9, pages 3197-3222 of American Economic Review, September 2026, Abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial...
abstract_status: 来源仅提供摘要预览，系统将自动重试完整摘要
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年时期的邻里环境对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。若干市场失灵现象可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，以及混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于资本市场上以儿童未来收入为抵押的借贷不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化的住房流动服务结合补贴性住房券，有助于低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。基于地点的政策若能营造混合收入社区，则似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。（JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38）
title: Presidential Address: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
title_zh: 总统致辞：邻里效应与机会市场的缺失

abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows, and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2-3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time, and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare.
abstract_zh: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率与直达服务之间进行权衡。我们以印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张为例，研究这些权衡关系。通过分析新增直达线路、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短对公交客流量和总体客流的影响，并利用线路开通事件匹配数据估算交通网络需求模型。研究发现：雅加达通勤者对等待时间的敏感度是公交行驶时间的2-3倍，且对长距离线路关注度较低。我们构建了一个灵活的分析框架来刻画最优网络特征，结果表明：降低网络集中度将有助于提升客流量与通勤者福利。
title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World’s Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
title_zh: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据

abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in U.S. history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their pre-existing legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms’ investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short-run, 87% of private income gains flow to the top 10% of the income distribution.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国历史上最大规模的企业所得税削减对企业和工人的影响。为识别因果效应，我们使用了雇主-雇员匹配的税务记录，并通过事件研究法比较同一行业中规模相近但因既有法律地位不同而面临不同税收变化的企业。减税导致企业投资、销售额、利润、就业和工资总额增加，但收入增长主要集中在高薪工人群体。短期内，私人收入增长的87%流向了收入分布前10%的人群。
title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers’ Earnings
title_zh: 企业减税、企业增长与工人收入

abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions. (JEL D44, D82)
abstract_zh: 设计者采用动态协议来获取私人信息。协议会产生一系列情境性隐私侵犯——即在特定情境下可能属于多余的信息被获知。若不存在其他协议能在实现选择规则的同时，产生该协议所引发侵犯行为的真子集，则该协议具有最大情境隐私性。当选择规则使某些代理人集体成为关键角色（而非个体关键角色）时，便会产生情境性隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，实现情境隐私性设计需要确定向每位代理人提出的初始问题及询问代理人的顺序。对于k物品维克里拍卖而言，升序接入协议具有最大情境隐私性。
title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
title_zh: 情境化隐私机制

abstract: Efficient risk-sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). We describe all preferences which permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures, and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial.
abstract_zh: 有效风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）存在一个简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以共同价格。标准方法通过总支出推断MUEs，隐含假设了同质性偏好、单位收入弹性以及相同的价格弹性。基于总支出的风险分担检验适用于异质性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“协变量”冲击（价格变化）。我们描述了所有允许从支出推断MUEs的偏好类型，并估计了非同质性MUEs，以检验乌干达的协变量冲击是否得到有效分担。这一方法得出了合理的结果；而标准方法则暗示干旱、洪水和虫害是有益的。
title: Risk Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
title_zh: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪涝与虫害

abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a highstakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time-stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black, but not White, patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在高风险场景——医疗保健中——导致基于种族的配给。利用涵盖某大型医疗系统107,000例住院患者的详细时间戳数据，我们发现当医院达到容量上限时，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则未出现此现象。这些发现无法通过患者选择的差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给机制，并记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情较轻的白人患者等待更长时间。对非结构化临床记录的文本分析揭示了医护人员努力程度的配给是另一机制。
title: Rationing by Race
title_zh: 按种族配给

abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online healthcare, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4% (s.e. 1.3); reallocations also reduce counter-guideline antibiotics by 3.1% (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching: horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted.
abstract_zh: 数字平台降低了地理摩擦，使服务提供者与用户之间的匹配更加高效。本文利用瑞典在线医疗中全国范围内基于时间的条件随机分配机制，量化了患者与医生重新匹配带来的收益。将高风险患者与能有效降低急诊就诊次数的医生匹配后，急诊就诊次数减少了4.4%（标准误1.3）；此类重新匹配还使违反指南的抗生素使用减少了3.1%（标准误1.4）。研究发现匹配中的权衡有限：医生间的横向差异化与患者需求的多样性使得多项指标可同时改善。提升效率的重新匹配也会影响公平性。研究结果凸显了在地理约束消除后，根据患者需求调整医疗服务提供者异质性的组织重组潜力。
title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
title_zh: 超越距离？数字时代的医疗服务供给

abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age 5 among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high return investment, with a conservatively estimated $4.1 in benefits for each $1 the policy would cost the government in the long-run.
abstract_zh: 我们基于随机对照试验和15年纵向追踪数据，提供了低收入环境下中等教育补贴代际影响的实验证据。中学奖学金推迟了生育年龄，减少了意外怀孕并改变了伴侣选择。一岁以下儿童死亡率降低了一半。我们还发现，女性奖学金获得者子女在5岁时的认知发展测试得分提高了0.24个标准差。经经济状况调查的中学奖学金是一项高回报投资，保守估计每1美元政策长期成本可为政府带来4.1美元收益。
title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
title_zh: 中等教育的代际影响：来自加纳的实验证据

abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的决策由机器学习算法指导。然而，当具有重大影响的决策被编码为算法时，个体可能会策略性地改变自身行为以达成预期结果。本文开发了一种实证方法，通过调整决策算法来预判操纵行为。通过明确建模操纵动机，我们的方法能够产生即使在完全透明规则下也能在操纵中保持稳定的决策规则。我们通过在肯尼亚开展的大规模实地实验对该方法进行了压力测试。实施结果表明，线性策略稳健决策规则的表现优于LASSO等标准线性模型。
title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction
title_zh: 抗操纵预测

abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intra-household investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic group specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants’ cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children’s education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial - though heterogeneous- cultural integration rates across immigrant groups.
abstract_zh: 我们将文化融合视为婚姻匹配在文化与教育维度上的均衡结果，以及家庭内部关于生育与文化社会化的投资决策。我们的模型能够识别特定文化族群的投资参数及配偶对婚姻匹配的偏好。结构估计显示，移民群体对保持文化身份具有强烈诉求，而本土居民对移民文化多样性的接纳程度有限。此外，这些估计揭示了不同文化背景下父母对子女教育价值的显著异质性。尽管如此，我们的模拟结果表明，各移民群体间存在显著但具有异质性的文化融合率。
title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
title_zh: 意大利的婚姻、生育与文化融合

abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the U.S. We show that CO2-intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt, and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multi-sector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国企业所得税与二氧化碳排放之间的关系。研究表明，二氧化碳密集型企业在债务税收优惠中获益更多，且其资本收入缴纳的所得税更低。基于这些新发现，我们提供了证据表明企业所得税税率下调会促使清洁企业实现更大规模的扩张。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型来解释这一现象，并量化了企业税制改革对总排放量的影响。一项消除债务税收优惠的政策可在不影响GDP的情况下减少总排放量。
title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
title_zh: 企业所得税的环境偏向

abstract: We develop a method for delineating prime locations—ultra-dense clusters of economic activity—within cities and apply it to comprehensive establishment data covering all US metropolitan areas. We further use big data to extend the analysis to a global context where administrative data are sparse. Many cities in the US and around the world are dominated by a small number of prime locations that can concentrate up to one-half of tradable services jobs on tiny shares of land and are dominant centers of economic gravity. In cities with fewer prime locations, a larger tradable services share concentrates in them.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在城市内部划定核心区位（即经济活动超密集集群）的方法，并将其应用于覆盖美国全部大都市区的综合性企业数据。进一步利用大数据将分析扩展至行政数据稀缺的全球范围。美国及全球众多城市的核心区位数量有限，这些区域能以极小比例的土地集中高达一半的可贸易服务业岗位，并成为主导性的经济引力中心。在核心区位较少的城市中，可贸易服务业岗位的集中度更高。
title: Prime Locations
title_zh: 黄金地段

abstract: We introduce a model in which a benevolent news outlet decides whether to report the realization of a state to a consumer, who pays a cost to receive it. A simple statistical rule, called a proper scoring rule, describes when the outlet should be more likely to report the realization. Using data from the US television news, we show that a particular scoring rule successfully predicts many salient features of news reporting. We show how to use this rule as a control variable to discipline tests of reporting bias, and we show that controlling for it matters in our applications.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中一家秉持善意的新闻机构决定是否向消费者报告某一状态的实现情况，而消费者需为此支付接收成本。一种被称为"恰当评分规则"的简单统计准则，描述了新闻机构在何种情况下更可能报告该实现结果。基于美国电视新闻数据，我们证明该特定评分规则能够成功预测新闻报道的诸多显著特征。我们展示了如何将该规则作为控制变量来约束报道偏误检验，并证实了在应用场景中控制该变量的重要性。
title: What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 什么是值得报道的新闻？理论与证据

abstract: This paper studies Markov perfect equilibria in a repeated duopoly model where sellers choose algorithms. An algorithm is a mapping from the competitor’s price to own price. Once set, the algorithms respond quickly. Customers arrive randomly and sellers can periodically revise their algorithms. The main results are that (i) for the simple two-price model with standard profit functions, monopoly pricing is the unique equilibrium outcome, and (ii) for any general finite price grid, all equilibrium outcomes feature supra-competitive pricing. Sustenance of such collusion seems outside the scope of current antitrust laws for it does not involve any direct communication.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个重复双寡头模型中的马尔可夫完美均衡，其中卖方选择算法。算法是从竞争对手价格到自身价格的映射。一旦设定，算法会快速响应。顾客随机到达，卖方可以定期修改其算法。主要结论是：（i）对于具有标准利润函数的简单两价格模型，垄断定价是唯一的均衡结果；（ii）对于任何一般有限价格网格，所有均衡结果均呈现超竞争定价。这种合谋的维持似乎超出了现行反垄断法的适用范围，因为它不涉及任何直接沟通。
title: Pricing with Algorithms
title_zh: 算法定价

abstract: The movement of labor out of the agricultural sector is a central feature of the development process. A long-held belief is that successful development requires that much of the labor released from agriculture be allocated to manufacturing rather than services. Rodrik’s (2013) finding of unconditional convergence for manufacturing productivity using data from UNIDO provided empirical support for this view. We argue that the UNIDO data are ill–suited to study cross-country productivity dynamics. We use recently released data from the GGDC that was developed especially to study cross-country sectoral productivity dynamics to revisit this issue. We find no evidence of unconditional convergence in manufacturing productivity over the period 1990–2018.
abstract_zh: 劳动力从农业部门转移是发展进程的核心特征。长期以来，人们普遍认为成功的发展需要将农业释放的大部分劳动力配置到制造业而非服务业。Rodrik（2013）基于联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）数据发现的制造业生产率无条件趋同现象，为这一观点提供了实证支持。我们认为UNIDO数据并不适用于研究跨国生产率动态。本文采用GGDC最新发布的、专为研究跨国部门生产率动态而开发的数据集重新审视该问题。研究发现，1990-2018年期间不存在制造业生产率无条件趋同的证据。
title: Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: A Reassessment
title_zh: 制造业的无条件收敛：一个再评估

abstract: Using data obtained from human resources consulting firms, we document the cost to large firms of hiring managers and business professionals in 146 countries worldwide. The average pay in the poorest decile of countries is $18,000 per year, which is 9.7 times GDP per worker. In contrast, in the richest decile of countries, large firms pay managers and business professionals only 0.8 times GDP per worker. We use an appropriate technology model to show that the cost of management could be an important deterrent to the expansion of the modern sector in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 利用从人力资源咨询公司获取的数据，我们记录了全球146个国家大型企业招聘管理人员和商务专业人士的成本。在收入最低的十分位国家中，平均年薪为18,000美元，是人均GDP的9.7倍。相比之下，在收入最高的十分位国家中，大型企业支付给管理人员和商务专业人士的薪酬仅为人均GDP的0.8倍。我们采用适宜技术模型表明，管理成本可能是阻碍发展中国家现代部门扩张的重要因素。
title: The Missing Middle Managers: Labor Costs, Firm Structure, and Development
title_zh: 缺失的中层管理者：劳动力成本、企业结构与发展

abstract: We show that the equilibrium loan-to-value (LTV) distribution in the US mortgage market has been remarkably stable over the last quarter century, both in aggregate and region-by-region, despite large, cross-sectionally heterogeneous house price cycles. While high-LTV mortgages changed from being explicitly government backed to privately securitized and back, their overall fraction re- mained unchanged. A repeat-sales methodology and an analysis of loan performance confirm that this stability in the distribution of LTVs holds even within subgroups of the population. These findings are inconsistent with models of credit cycles that use changes in collateral constraints to generate boom-bust dynamics in house prices.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，美国抵押贷款市场的均衡贷款价值比分布在过去25年中保持显著稳定，无论是在总体层面还是区域层面，尽管房价周期存在显著的横截面异质性。高贷款价值比抵押贷款从明确由政府支持转变为私人证券化，再回归政府支持，但其总体占比始终未变。重复销售方法及贷款表现分析进一步证实，即使在人口子群体内部，贷款价值比分布的稳定性依然成立。这些发现与利用抵押品约束变化生成房价繁荣-萧条动态的信贷周期模型不一致。
title: The Missing Loan-to-Value Cycle
title_zh: 缺失的贷款价值比周期

abstract: We analyze data from one elite institution and find that test score optional policies harm the likelihood of admission for high achieving applicants from disadvantaged backgrounds. Under test optional policies, these applicants submit test scores at too low a rate; they more than double their admissions probability (from 2.9 percent to 7.2 percent) by reporting scores. Our findings suggest that, more than commonly understood, elite institutions interpret test scores in the context of an applicant’s background. Thus, availability of test scores on an application can promote rather than hinder social mobility.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一所精英院校的数据，发现考试分数可选政策损害了来自弱势背景的高成就申请者的录取机会。在考试分数可选政策下，这些申请者提交分数的比例过低；若提交分数，其录取概率将提升一倍以上（从2.9%升至7.2%）。我们的研究结果表明，精英院校在解读考试分数时，比普遍认知更注重申请者的背景信息。因此，申请材料中提供考试分数反而能促进而非阻碍社会流动性。
title: How Test Optional Policies in College Admissions Disproportionately Harm High Achieving Applicants from Disadvantaged Backgrounds
title_zh: 大学招生中的可选考试政策如何不成比例地损害来自弱势背景的高成就申请者

abstract: We propose an equilibrium theory of data-driven antitrust oversight in which regu- lators launch investigations on the basis of suspicious bidding patterns and cartels can adapt to the statistical screens used by regulators. Our main result establishes that screening for collusion using tests with a low false-positive rate (safe tests) is a robust improvement over laissez-faire. Safe tests do not create new collusive equilibria, and do not hurt competitive industries. In addition, safe tests can have strict bite, including unraveling all collusive equilibria in some settings.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种数据驱动反垄断监管的均衡理论，其中监管机构基于可疑投标模式发起调查，而卡特尔组织能够适应监管机构使用的统计筛查手段。我们的主要结论表明，采用低误报率（安全检验）的合谋筛查方法，相较于自由放任政策具有稳健的改进效果。安全检验既不会催生新的合谋均衡，也不会损害竞争性行业。此外，安全检验具有严格约束力，在某些情境下甚至能瓦解所有合谋均衡。
title: Screening Adaptive Cartels
title_zh: 筛选适应性卡特尔

abstract: Intermediary asset pricing posits that financial institutions play a central role in financial markets, and that their decisions shape asset prices beyond simply reflecting the preferences of the average household. This perspective helps make sense of key empirical patterns: the excess volatility of asset prices, differences in price movements across asset classes, the cross-section of expected returns within asset classes, and specific arbitrage opportunities and price dislocations. We also review the implications of intermediary asset pricing for macroeconomic dynamics, international economics, and policy. In this approach, a primary channel of financial regulation and monetary policy is through alleviating constraints or removing risk from intermediary balance sheets during periods of stress. We highlight both existing progress and gaps for future research.
abstract_zh: 中介资产定价理论认为，金融机构在金融市场中扮演核心角色，其决策不仅反映普通家庭的平均偏好，更直接塑造资产价格。这一视角有助于解释关键实证现象：资产价格的过度波动、不同资产类别间的价格差异、同类资产预期收益率的截面特征，以及特定套利机会与价格错位。本文还梳理了中介资产定价对宏观经济动态、国际经济学及政策制定的启示。在该理论框架下，金融监管与货币政策的主要传导渠道，是在压力时期缓解中介机构面临的约束或消除其资产负债表风险。我们既总结了现有研究进展，也指出了未来需要填补的空白。
title: Intermediaries and Asset Prices
title_zh: 中介机构与资产价格

abstract: Refugees are international migrants escaping persecution and crises, whose economic success in their countries of destination is threatened by lack of access to labor and credit markets, limited information on employment opportunities, and loss of human capital and assets. In this paper, we review the economic literature that analyzes and evaluates interventions designed to address these hurdles and facilitate refugees’ economic integration. We also draw important general lessons from a wide variety of these interventions and identify areas for further research.
abstract_zh: 难民是因逃避迫害和危机而跨国迁移的人群，其在目的地国的经济成功面临劳动力与信贷市场准入受限、就业机会信息匮乏、人力资本与资产流失等多重威胁。本文系统梳理了旨在破解上述障碍、促进难民经济融入的经济学干预措施相关文献，通过提炼各类干预方案中的普适性经验，为后续研究指明方向。
title: Refugees’ Economic Integration
title_zh: 难民的经济融合

abstract: Something is amiss in empirical economics. Despite the advances of the credibility revolution, published estimates tend to be inflated and overconfident. We argue that this stems from a weakness in the dominant econometric framework: treating the researcher like a calculator that mechanically implements the econometric method. We use several examples to show how properties of estimators change dramatically with humans in the loop. Under plausible assumptions on researcher behavior, low-power estimators such as instrumental variables exhibit high degrees of bias, even with a first-stage F-statistic of 200. Threshold testing on the first-stage F-statistic can reduce bias, contrary to Angrist and Kolesár (2024). And standard errors understate uncertainty, since they ignore variation due to researchers’ subjective choices. Ignoring the role of humans “in the research loop” can lead to highly biased and unreliable findings. Modifying econometric practices to address the human factor is a critical frontier of the credibility revolution. (JEL C12, C13, C26)
abstract_zh: 实证经济学中存在某种偏差。尽管可信性革命取得了进展，但已发表的估计结果往往存在膨胀和过度自信的问题。我们认为，这源于主流计量经济学框架的一个缺陷：将研究者视为机械执行计量方法的计算器。我们通过多个案例展示了当人类介入研究过程时，估计量的性质会发生显著变化。在关于研究者行为的合理假设下，即使第一阶段F统计量达到200，工具变量等低功效估计量仍会表现出高度偏误。与Angrist和Kolesár（2024）的结论相反，对第一阶段F统计量进行阈值检验可以降低偏误。而标准误低估了不确定性，因为它忽略了研究者主观选择带来的变异。忽视"研究循环"中人类角色的作用，可能导致高度偏误且不可靠的研究结论。调整计量实践以应对人为因素，是可信性革命的关键前沿。
title: Humans in the Loop: The Next Frontier in the Credibility Revolution
title_zh: 人类在循环中：可信度革命的下一个前沿

abstract: We review the flourishing literature on the automobile industry since the seminal work of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995), or briefly BLP. Their work provides a structural equilibrium framework that forms a basis for conducting policy counterfactuals in several key areas of interest: competition policy and antitrust, trade policy, and taxation and environmental policy. The demand side of the ‘BLP framework’ is micro-founded and allows for rich consumer heterogeneity to generate flexible substitution patterns between products. The supply side specifies marginal costs and accounts for imperfect competition. Our analysis focuses on two main questions. First, how has the framework been tailored to specific situations and how convincingly has it been evaluated to generate trust in the empirical findings and policy conclusions? Second, what has been learned about policy issues relevant in the automotive industry using the BLP equilibrium framework?
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了自Berry、Levinsohn与Pakes（1995，简称BLP）开创性研究以来蓬勃发展的汽车产业文献。其构建的结构性均衡框架为竞争政策与反垄断、贸易政策、税收与环境政策等关键领域的政策反事实分析奠定了基础。BLP框架的需求侧具有微观基础，通过丰富的消费者异质性刻画产品间的灵活替代模式；供给侧则明确边际成本设定并纳入不完全竞争因素。我们的分析聚焦两大核心问题：第一，该框架如何针对特定情境进行适应性调整，其评估过程在多大程度上能令人信服地支撑实证发现与政策结论？第二，借助BLP均衡框架，我们对汽车产业相关政策议题获得了哪些认知？
title: Demand, Competition, and Public Policy in the Automobile Industry
title_zh: 汽车行业的需求、竞争与公共政策

abstract: In Unforgiving Places , Jens Ludwig makes a strong claim for the behavioral economics of crime, scoring it a knockout when pitted against conventional wisdom. Focusing on gun violence, he proposes a unifying explanation that draws on disciplines beyond economics, especially sociology, criminology, and psychology. Although the intended audience is mainly policymakers and the general public, scholars will benefit from reading Ludwig’s thought-provoking book. In this essay, I evaluate the book’s evidence and elaborate on the research needed to resolve unsettled hypotheses. I focus on several key issues, including linking self-control theory to cognitive processes; informal neighborhood social control; legitimacy in community policing; toxic environmental effects on cognition; the limits of administrative data; age-specific pathways of gun carrying; and the impact of social change. In the spirit of consilience that Unforgiving Places calls for, I argue that further engagement of the book’s framework with these issues yields a promising research agenda.
abstract_zh: 在《无情之地》一书中，延斯·路德维希对犯罪的行为经济学提出了有力主张，认为相较于传统观念，该理论具有压倒性优势。他聚焦枪支暴力问题，提出了一种融合经济学之外多学科（尤其是社会学、犯罪学与心理学）的统一解释框架。尽管本书主要面向政策制定者与普通公众，但学者们亦能从路德维希发人深省的论述中获益。本文评估了该书的证据基础，并详细阐述了解决未决假说所需的研究方向。我重点关注若干关键议题，包括：将自我控制理论与认知过程相联结；非正式邻里社会控制机制；社区警务中的合法性；有毒环境对认知的影响；行政数据的局限性；携带枪支的年龄特异性路径；以及社会变革的影响。秉承《无情之地》所倡导的“知识融通”精神，我认为将该书框架进一步延伸至这些议题，将催生富有前景的研究议程。
title: Scoring the Behavioral Economics of Crime: Reflections on Unforgiving Places: The Unexpected Origins of American Gun Violence
title_zh: 评分犯罪的行为经济学：对《不宽容之地：美国枪支暴力的意外起源》的反思

abstract: We consider why fertility has fallen in recent decades in almost all high-income countries. We begin by documenting declining total fertility and rising childlessness across cohorts, highlighting the need to focus on cohort versus period-specific fertility rates. With this motivation, we propose a conceptual model of fertility determination that augments the standard Becker model with an explicit role for social norms and cohort-specific contextual factors, including broad social and economic influences and an expanded set of consumption and lifestyle options. We posit that these forces have led to “shifting priorities,” reducing the centrality of parenthood. We then review existing empirical evidence –and conclude that the decline in fertility likely reflects a complex mix of changing norms around work, parenting, gender roles, and leisure consistent with our cohort-based conceptual framework. We conclude with suggestions for future research and a brief discussion of policy implications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了近几十年来几乎所有高收入国家生育率下降的原因。我们首先记录了不同世代群体中总和生育率的下降及无子女现象的上升，强调需关注世代特定生育率而非时期特定生育率。基于此，我们提出一个生育决定的概念模型，该模型在标准贝克尔模型基础上，引入社会规范与世代特定情境因素（包括广泛的社会经济影响及扩大的消费与生活方式选择）的显性作用。我们假设这些力量导致了“优先事项的转变”，削弱了为人父母的核心地位。随后，我们回顾现有实证证据，并得出结论：生育率下降可能反映了围绕工作、育儿、性别角色及休闲的规范变迁的复杂组合，这与我们基于世代的概念框架一致。最后，我们提出未来研究建议并简要讨论政策启示。
title: Why Is Fertility So Low in High-Income Countries?
title_zh: 为什么高收入国家生育率如此之低？

abstract: The ongoing revolution in deep learning is reshaping research across many fields, including economics. Its effects are especially clear in solving dynamic economic models. These models often lack closed-form solutions, so economists have long relied on numerical methods such as value function iteration, perturbation, and projection techniques. Unfortunately, these approaches suffer from the curse of dimensionality, which makes global solutions computationally infeasible as the number of state variables increases. Deep learning offers a different approach: flexible tools that solve dynamic economic models by minimizing residuals in equilibrium conditions, and that can handle high-dimensional problems. This development promises to broaden the scope of quantitative economics. I illustrate the approach using the neoclassical growth model.
abstract_zh: 深度学习的持续革命正在重塑包括经济学在内的众多领域的研究格局。其在动态经济模型求解方面的作用尤为显著。由于这类模型通常缺乏闭式解，经济学家长期以来依赖数值方法，如值函数迭代、摄动法和投影技术。遗憾的是，这些方法受困于维度灾难——随着状态变量数量的增加，全局解在计算上变得不可行。深度学习提供了一种不同的路径：通过最小化均衡条件残差来求解动态经济模型的灵活工具，能够处理高维问题。这一发展有望拓宽定量经济学的应用范围。本文以新古典增长模型为例阐释该方法。
title: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
title_zh: 深度学习求解经济模型
